stories.title: Indian stocks reach highest levels since February
stories.summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty closed at their highest levels since February on Tuesday. The rally, which has seen local equities gain roughly 10 percent this month, was supported by record foreign inflows of 9.53 billion dollars and easing crude oil prices. Markets are currently defying global trends.

Markets remain unsettled by concerns regarding the rapid expansion of AI infrastructure and the upcoming Anthropic IPO, which is targeted at 1.4 trillion dollars.

stories.title: Stocks slide as Anthropic IPO approaches
stories.summary: US stocks closed lower on Tuesday as investors braced for Nvidia’s earnings and the upcoming Anthropic IPO, which is targeted to raise $1.4 trillion. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq recorded their first four-day streak of declines since September. Every sector in the S&P 500 finished the day down.

stories.title: Wall Street dips ahead of Nvidia report
stories.summary: Wall Street traded lower Tuesday as investors exercised caution ahead of Nvidia’s first earnings report since the resignation of chief executive Jensen Huang. The executive stepped down following revelations of an affair with a businesswoman suspected of helping Chinese companies obtain restricted chips. The results are due after the bell.

stories.title: RBI’s reply to Tata Sons triggers debate over suo motu powers
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India’s latest communication to Tata Sons has raised questions over the regulator’s reliance on the company’s internal board meeting proceedings to frame its position on the need for a listing, even though the company had not sought clarification on any specific regulatory provision, legal experts said.

stories.title: RBI issues API security advisory to banks
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has issued an advisory on API governance for banks and non-banking financial companies. The framework covers development, deployment, and security monitoring as digital connections between financial institutions and external providers emerge as a growing cyber risk. The central bank is now monitoring the connections.

stories.title: Tata Group stocks rally on listing directive
stories.summary: Shares of Tata Group companies rose Tuesday after the Reserve Bank of India directed Tata Sons to comply with listing requirements for upper-layer non-banking financial companies. Tata Chemicals shares surged nearly 9 percent. The holding company’s unlisted status has returned to the center of investor attention.

stories.title: Madras High Court rules on fraud compensation
stories.summary: The Madras High Court held that a 2017 RBI fraud compensation circular applies retrospectively and covers private sector banks. The court rejected Axis Bank’s objections, noting that RBI directions apply to all banks to safeguard customer deposits. The bank must now recredit 16.15 lakh rupees to a customer.

stories.title: Axis Bank executive director reappointed
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has approved the reappointment of Munish Sharda as an executive director at Axis Bank for a three-year term. Sharda, who has served in the role since February 2024, will continue to oversee retail liabilities, branch banking, and commercial banking through February 2030.

stories.title: IDBI Bank unions protest Fairfax sale
stories.summary: IDBI Bank unions have asked the Reserve Bank of India to withhold approval for the proposed sale of the bank to Fairfax. The unions, which describe the bank as a national asset, have called for a strike on December 3 to oppose the transfer of majority ownership.

stories.title: Fintech fest highlights India's digital infrastructure
stories.summary: The 7th Global Fintech Fest 2026 showcased India's digital public infrastructure, including Aadhaar and the Unified Payments Interface. The event highlighted how these technologies enable digital identity and consent-based data sharing at population scale. India is currently reshaping the global fintech landscape through scale and innovation.

stories.title: MOS Utility focuses on last-mile digital payments
stories.summary: MOS Utility Limited is targeting rural and underserved communities to expand its digital payment network. While urban markets have seen significant fintech growth, the company aims to address the gap in last-mile financial infrastructure for millions of individuals and small merchants across India.

stories.title: SEI opens Hyderabad global capability centre
stories.summary: US-based financial technology company SEI has opened a global capability centre in Hyderabad, employing 800 professionals. The facility includes 1,200 workstations to support technology and financial operations. Hyderabad has attracted approximately 150 new global capability centres over the last 30 months.

stories.title: UPI remains default payment choice in India
stories.summary: A decade after its launch, the Unified Payments Interface has become the default payment method across income groups and business types in India. The platform now serves as the foundation for banks, fintechs and lenders as they develop their next generation of business services.

stories.title: Debate intensifies over UPI merchant discount rates
stories.summary: The digital payments ecosystem is weighing the future of the Unified Payments Interface as discussions around merchant discount rates continue. Stakeholders are divided on whether merchants should bear transaction costs, with third-party application providers and merchants questioning who will ultimately sustain the platform's growth.

stories.title: MobiKwik projects revenue boost from UPI
stories.summary: MobiKwik expects the proposed merchant discount rate on UPI transactions to add at least 100 crore rupees to its payments revenue in the next fiscal year. The company has raised its profit target for the 2028 financial year to 100 crore rupees based on these projections.

stories.title: Working capital needs new credit models
stories.summary: Viable mid-market companies remain cash-starved because finance does not move at the pace of trade, according to Sapphiro MD. Long payment cycles lock earnings in receivables, while collateral-heavy lending requires businesses to pledge assets for work already completed. The issue will be discussed at the Singapore FinTech Festival.

stories.title: MapmyIndia integrates with Zoho's Arattai
stories.summary: MapmyIndia has integrated its Mappls navigation app with Zoho's Arattai messaging platform. The partnership allows users to open shared locations and receive turn-by-turn directions directly within the chat app. The feature is available on both Android and iOS devices.

stories.title: SEBI updates KYC and tax reporting requirements
stories.summary: SEBI has directed registered intermediaries to update their customer onboarding and KYC frameworks to comply with the Income-tax Rules, 2026. These requirements cover financial accounts under the Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act and Common Reporting Standard. The rules took effect on April 1, 2026.

stories.title: Research links SIP duration to better outcomes
stories.summary: A Motilal Oswal Mutual Fund study covering 21 years found that increasing the duration of systematic investment plans reduces the probability of poor outcomes. The data shows that SIPs held for longer periods historically recorded fewer negative returns across Nifty 100 and Nifty Midcap 150 indices.

stories.title: Nifty 100 faces potential end to winning streak
stories.summary: The Nifty 100 index is at risk of ending a 10-year streak of positive calendar-year returns as it hovers near the flatline for 2026. Analysts suggest that a potential end to the streak does not necessarily require investors to change their long-term equity allocation strategy.

stories.title: Investor retires at 30 using rental income
stories.summary: A man in China retired at 30 after purchasing 14 older apartments to generate rental income. Fan Junjue, who previously worked 18-hour shifts in internet healthcare sales, bought the properties for approximately 45,000 dollars each. He now plans to invest his earnings in dividend stocks.

stories.title: Generali introduces premium waiver rider
stories.summary: Generali Central Life Insurance has launched a rider that allows policyholders to stop paying premiums if they face accidental disability, critical illness or death. The policy benefits continue as originally planned. The insurer aims to strengthen financial protection for policyholders under these specified circumstances.

stories.title: Indian investors face hurdles for Anthropic IPO
stories.summary: Indian retail investors may find it difficult to participate in Anthropic's upcoming US initial public offering. Most investment platforms available to Indian residents only provide access to US stocks after they begin trading on an exchange, making initial allotment participation a challenge for domestic investors.

stories.title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana returns detailed
stories.summary: The government-backed Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana offers an 8.2 percent annual interest rate for the current quarter. Parents contributing 5,000 rupees monthly for 15 years could accumulate approximately 27.73 lakh rupees by the time the account matures after 21 years.

stories.title: RBI mandates free annual credit reports
stories.summary: Individuals in India can access one free full credit report annually from each of the four registered credit information companies. The Reserve Bank of India mandate allows consumers to monitor their credit scores and repayment history without paying subscription fees to TransUnion CIBIL, Experian, Equifax or CRIF High Mark.

stories.title: Investors weigh LRS rules amid speculation
stories.summary: Speculation that the Reserve Bank of India may introduce sub-limits on Liberalised Remittance Scheme transactions has prompted some investors to consider moving funds early. While no official restrictions have been announced, investors are monitoring the situation to diversify portfolios before potential changes to the current rules.

stories.title: Borrowers warned on gold loan risks
stories.summary: Rising gold prices allow borrowers to unlock larger loans against their jewellery, but financial experts advise checking repayment capacity before increasing debt. Borrowing more simply because collateral value has increased could lead to unnecessary financial strain if gold prices correct in the future.

stories.title: ITAT rules property allotment rights are capital assets
stories.summary: The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal ruled that rights from a property allotment letter qualify as a capital asset even before possession. Surrendering these rights for compensation now attracts capital gains tax. The taxman has decided that a promise of a home is as good as the home itself.

stories.title: EPFO launches WhatsApp service for account access
stories.summary: EPFO members can now check balances and view recent transactions via WhatsApp without using the member portal. The service requires a registered mobile number linked to a Universal Account Number. The retirement fund body has moved its paperwork to the app where people already send memes.

stories.title: Nine mutual fund NFOs open for subscription this week
stories.summary: Nine new fund offerings open between November 16 and 20, covering sectoral, index, hybrid and thematic strategies. Minimum investments start at 100 rupees and reach 10 lakh rupees. The market has decided that nine new ways to hold the same stocks are necessary.
